mapper.select: SELECT user_id AS userId, workspace_id AS workspaceId, role_id AS roleId, tenant_id AS tenantId FROM user_workspace_role WHERE user_id = #{userId}

SELECT DISTINCT r.id, r.code, r.name, r.status, r.del_flag AS delFlag, r.create_time AS createTime, r.update_time AS updateTime FROM role r INNER JOIN user_workspace_role uwr ON r.id = uwr.role_id WHERE uwr.user_id = #{userId} AND r.status = '1' AND r.del_flag = 0 ORDER BY r.id
